Từ tri thức – Đến hành động – Vì tương l: From Knowledge — To Action — For a Sustainable Future
Thế giới hiện đại đang đối mặt với những: The modern world is facing increasingly complex and global challenges such as climate change, resource depletion, socio-economic instability, digital transformation, and artificial intelligence, along with the urgent need for sustainable development and modern governance systems. In this context, the gap between academic research and practical application, and between scientific thinking and social action, remains a major barrier in the development journey of many countries and organizations.
Xuất phát từ kinh nghiệm thực tiễn đa lĩ: Stemming from multi-disciplinary and interdisciplinary practical experience — from development research, strategic consulting, education and training, to economics, business, management, psychology, agri-food, environment, and sustainable development — the founders realized an urgent need for an organization capable of connecting interdisciplinary scientific knowledge with business and market realities.
Một tổ chức như vậy không chỉ góp phần g: Such an organization would not only help solve the complex problems of the era but also create long-term value and promote sustainable prosperity for society. GISA was born from that aspiration, with the companionship of scientists, experts, entrepreneurs, leaders, and global organizations — people who share the same ideal of dedicating themselves to a better world.
Viện Phát triển Bền vững và Quản lý Nâng: The Global Institute for Sustainable Development and Advanced Management (GISA) is a non-profit-oriented scientific and technological organization, built on the foundation of combining profound academic and scientific thinking with effective strategic and practical action.
Kinh nghiệm thực tiễn làm định hướng\nNg:
Practical experience as the direction
Scientific research as the foundation
Global network as the strength
Chúng tôi tích hợp các tiếp cận liên ngà: We integrate interdisciplinary approaches, technology application, data, innovation, and multi-dimensional execution capacity to contribute to solving complex problems in modern development and governance. GISA pioneers in the fields of research, consulting, training, and knowledge transfer, with a focus on applying modern technology and advanced management models to deliver breakthrough solutions that help businesses, organizations, and communities achieve sustainable, efficient, and adaptive development in the digital age.
Tới năm 2030, GISA trở thành đơn vị tiên: By 2030, GISA aims to become a pioneering, highly reputable, and widely recognized institution in knowledge and practice in the fields of innovation, sustainable development, and advanced management in Vietnam and the region, through its core pillars of research, consulting, training, application transfer, promoting global cooperation networks, and community contributions.
GISA thúc đẩy phát triển bền vững và thị: GISA promotes global sustainable development and prosperity through interdisciplinary research, innovation, knowledge transfer, scientific and technological applications, and the creation of social values. We connect scientists, experts, leaders, businesses, and organizations worldwide to provide practical, effective, and deeply impactful solutions based on a solid scientific foundation — for a civilized, prosperous, and sustainable world.
Nghiên cứu và phát triển tri thức liên n: Interdisciplinary Knowledge Research and Development. Conduct in-depth scientific research and multidisciplinary applied research to generate knowledge with practical value, serving sustainable development strategies and modern governance.
Thúc đẩy đổi mới sáng tạo và tư duy đột: Innovation and Breakthrough Thinking. Encourage, support, and spread innovative initiatives in governance, technology, education, and business models, contributing to the formation of advanced solutions that adapt to the times.
Chuyển giao tri thức và công nghệ ứng dụ: Knowledge and Applied Technology Transfer. Transform research works and academic knowledge into practical solutions through consulting, training, and technology transfer activities for businesses, organizations, and the community.
Kết nối và hợp tác toàn cầu. GISA xây dự: Global Connection and Cooperation. Build a global knowledge network, connecting scientists, experts, leaders, and entrepreneurs to share, collaborate, and create internationally linked solutions for the common good.
Ứng dụng khoa học – công nghệ vào thực t: Application of Science and Technology in Practice. Develop and deploy modern models, technologies, tools, and solutions to improve the operational efficiency, competitiveness, and adaptability of businesses and organizations in the digital and sustainable era.
Kiến tạo giá trị và lan tỏa tác động xã: Creating Value and Spreading Social Impact. Implement community initiatives, programs, and projects aimed at improving social welfare, protecting the environment, and promoting humane and sustainable development.
GISA dựa trên giá trị cốt lõi “RISES” vớ: GISA is founded on the core value system RISES, with five pillars aimed at a long-term vision and at fulfilling the stated mission: Reliability (trustworthiness, credibility, and integrity); Innovation (creativity and breakthrough); Science (scientific and standardized approaches); Efficiency (practical effectiveness and significance); and Sustainability (long-term sustainability). These core values are continuously improved and elevated.
Giá trị và uy tín dựa trên các nghiên cứ: Value and credibility based on highly reliable research and knowledge
A spirit of innovation, creativity, and breakthrough
Cách tiếp cận khoa học, hàn lâm và chuẩn: A scientific, academic, and standardized approach
Tính hiệu quả, ý nghĩa và giá trị thiết: Effectiveness, significance, and practical value for businesses and society
Sáu lĩnh vực hoạt động của GISA gắn với: GISA's six fields of operation are linked in a single chain: research generates knowledge, consulting and training bring that knowledge into organizations, application transfers it into solutions, networking expands resources, and community engagement spreads impact. Each field comes with a set of professional tools that are used on a regular basis.
